battle.name: 仆散揆攻宋之戰
battle.brief: 開禧二年（一二〇六）蒙古建國同年，札剌亦兒氏將領仆散揆率偏師自西夏境南下，抄掠宋國陝蜀沿邊堡寨、切斷其糧道，宋方由四川宣撫司主持防務，依險築寨固守。此役未聞大城攻陷，卡面十字弩正是宋軍守城倚重、蒙古騎兵在牆下難以施展的兵器。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 這場衝突發生在一二〇六年蒙古建國的同年，交戰雙方一邊是剛剛在斡難河大會諸部、頒布大札撒、建立怯薛宿衛並把草原各部編為九十五個千戶的新生大蒙古國，另一邊是偏安江南、正忙於開禧北伐的南宋。蒙古一方的指揮體系仍帶有部落聯盟的色彩，成吉思汗居中調度，諸部千戶長與百戶長各領本部，仆散揆是其中握有獨立兵權的統兵之將，出兵時自草原循西路南下，先取西夏境內的通道，再抵宋境。防守方是南宋的邊軍體系：陝西興元、沔州、金州一線屬利州路與四川四路的沿邊，軍政歸四川宣撫司節制，川陝防務多由四川宣撫副使、宣撫使一職總領；長江中游的荊湖北路、淮南西路與兩浙西路的邊軍則歸各路安撫司與樞密院調度。中原正線上的金朝此時正被宋軍開禧北伐牽制，蒙古兵並未與宋的主力接觸，而是選擇在宋的西面邊防上試探與抄掠。整體而言，這是一次以邊境堡寨為主的邊患衝突，而不是兩國全面開戰。
countriesEn: The engagement took place in 1206, the very year in which the Mongol Empire was proclaimed. On one side stood the newborn state of the Great Mongol nation: at the assembly on the Onon river the steppe tribes were united, the Yassa was promulgated, the keshig guard was established, and the peoples were reorganised into ninety-five thousand-households. Its command structure still carried the character of a tribal confederation, with Genghis Khan at the centre and thousand- and hundred-household leaders commanding their own contingents; Pusuge was one of the commanders holding independent troops, moving south along the western route, first taking the passes through Xixia territory before reaching Song borders. The defenders belonged to the Song frontier establishment: in Shaanxi the lines of Xingyuan, Mianzhou and Jinzhou formed the frontier of Lizhou and of the four circuits of Sichuan and were answerable to the Sichuan pacification commission, and military administration in Shaanxi and Sichuan was in the hands of the vice-pacification commissioner and then the pacification commissioner; the garrison districts of Jinghu north, Huainan west and Liangzhe west were dispatched by their own pacification offices and by the Bureau of Military Affairs. The Jin dynasty on the central plain was itself tied down by the Song offensive in Henan, and the Mongol troops never met the Song main force, choosing instead to probe and plunder on the western flank. On the whole this was a frontier disturbance fought around stockades, not a general war between the two states.
people: 核心人物是成吉思汗與仆散揆。成吉思汗於一二〇六年春在斡難河源聚會諸部、宣布建國，隨即整頓軍制，怯薛宿衛由初置的千人逐步擴充，他本人這一年大半時間都在處理西夏與內部的整合，遠征的兵馬部署與後勤補給都要經他決定。仆散揆一般認為出身札剌亦兒氏，與木華黎同族，是蒙古建國前後已經嶄露頭角的將領之一；他的名字見於蒙古與金兩方面的編年，在金人的記載中，他是以統兵侵入宋境的名將，可見宋人對這支偏師相當警覺。南宋一方，寧宗趙擴此時受韓侂胄主持的開禧北伐牽動，朝廷對北方用兵與西面防務的取捨一直存在爭議；四川方面由趙範接替吳挺主持軍政，一邊整飭州軍、一邊加固沿邊城寨與關隘，是宋方應對蒙古壓力的關鍵人物。此外，與蒙古並肩作戰的西夏末主襄宗安全，在連年征伐下求和稱臣，成為蒙古西進的附庸，這也讓這次攻宋變成蒙古、西夏與宋三方糾纏之下的邊境行動，而僕散揆正是執行這種越境牽制的一方統帥。
peopleEn: The central figures are Genghis Khan and Pusuge. In the spring of 1206 Genghis Khan gathered the tribes at the source of the Onon river, proclaimed the state and immediately reorganised the army; the keshig guard, first raised with a thousand men, was gradually enlarged, and for most of that year he was occupied with Xixia and with internal consolidation, so that the deployment of distant expeditions and their supply had to pass through his decisions. Pusuge is generally held to have been of the Jadaranda clan, the same clan as Muqali, and to have been one of the commanders who came to prominence around the founding of the empire; his name appears in the chronicles of both the Mongols and the Jin, and in Jin records he figures as a commander who led incursions into Song territory, which shows how seriously the Song took this detached force. On the Song side, Emperor Ningzong, Zhao Kuang, was pulled this way and that by the Kaixi northern expedition championed by Han Tuozhou, and the court's choice between fighting in the north and defending in the west was constantly contested; in Sichuan, Zhao Fan took over from Wu Ting in charge of military administration, disciplining the departmental troops while reinforcing the frontier stockades and passes, and was the key figure in the Song response to Mongol pressure. Alongside the Mongols stood the Western Xia under its last ruler, Xiangzong Quan, who after repeated campaigns sued for peace and submitted, becoming a vassal of the Mongols in the west; that submission turned the raid on Song into a border operation tangled among Mongols, Western Xia and Song, and Pusuge was precisely the commander who carried out this cross-border pressure.
kits: 卡面上的十字弩是宋軍守城與野戰中最典型的冷兵器，弩機、弩弦、矢筈與特製的弩矢構成了它的全部要害：弩弦以動物筋腱與蠶絲絞合，弩矢多用制竹或制木的箭桿配鐵鏃，穿甲能力雖不及宋軍弓弩中最負盛名的神臂弓，卻能在遠距離上壓制城頭與坡地的目標。弩最大的代價在裝填，一次拉弦、上弦、扣機的循環遠慢於開弓，因此它在城頭固定射位上最為可靠，離開射位、遭遇騎兵衝鋒時便十分脆弱。宋制弩兵除常見的步弩外，還有弓力更強的神臂弓，據《宋史·兵志》記載，其弓力約在三百斤上下，射程逾二百步，裝填同樣緩慢，卻是守城倚重的中型反制武器。蒙古這邊並不倚賴弩，早期蒙古軍大量使用反曲角弓，弓力不如宋制神臂弓，但箭速快、騎射兼備；十二世紀初的騎兵多穿皮甲或幾乎不披甲，只有近衛與重騎裝備札甲。除弓箭外，蒙古用於近戰的還有長柄矛與投石索，冷兵器之外則是從西夏與金境內取得的糧食、衣物與氈氈。同一時期南宋軍中已出現以竹筒裝填火藥的突火槍，射程短而聲勢驚人，與弩的高低搭配體現了十二世紀末攻防技術的過渡狀態。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card is the typical cold weapon of the Song army both in defence and in the field, and its whole apparatus consists of the lock, the string, the stirrup and its specially made bolts: the string was twisted from animal sinew and silk, and the bolts, with bamboo or wooden shafts and iron heads, could not pierce armour as well as the shenpi bow, the most celebrated of the Song crossbows, yet at long range they could dominate targets on walls and slopes. The price of the crossbow is the loading cycle, for stringing, drawing and releasing take far longer than nocking an arrow; it is therefore most reliable in a fixed firing position on a wall and extremely fragile once it leaves that position or meets charging cavalry. Besides the common hand crossbows the Song also had the shenpi bow, the stronger wall-scaling weapon, which the History of Song in its treatise on the military describes as having a draw weight of about three hundred jin and a range of more than two hundred paces; loading is just as slow, yet it was the mainstay of city defence. The Mongols did not rely on the crossbow. The early Mongol army used recurved composite bows whose draw fell short of the Song shenpi bow but whose arrows flew fast and could be loosed from the saddle, and in the early thirteenth century most riders wore leather armour or none at all, only the guard and the heavy cavalry wearing lamellar. Beside bows and arrows the Mongols carried long-shafted spears and slings for close work, and beyond cold weapons they drew food, clothing and felt from Xixia and Jin territory. In the same period the Song already had the tuohuo qiang, a bamboo tube loaded with gunpowder, of short range but great intimidation value; the way it was paired with the crossbow shows the transitional state of offensive and defensive technology at the end of the twelfth century.
tactics: 蒙古在這一年的用兵，延續了草原騎兵一貫的思路：不與防守方在城牆前糾纏太久，而是以高速機動切斷交通、分割敵地、逼迫守軍分兵。仆散揆的偏師在南下過程中多走荒僻山道，避開宋軍重兵把守的城池與大的堡寨，轉而襲擊糧秣隊伍、驅趕牲畜、切斷從關中與川北通往前線的道路，把宋邊軍拖入逐處設防、被動馳援的消耗。進入宋境後，蒙古騎兵遇到宋軍的步弩陣與神臂弓射界，通常選擇迂迴兩翼、斷其後路，而不是正面硬撞；遇到宋軍在堡寨中固守，則先以弓箭壓制牆頭、封鎖出入，等待宋方援軍疲憊或糧援中斷，再作進退之計。牆頭上，宋軍的戰術核心是弩：長弓射手負責遠程覆蓋，弩手在垛口後輪換射擊，專打爬上城頭的攀登者與掩護攻城的器械；城內留有突兵與夜襲的準備，試圖在蒙古營壘停頓、馬匹疲乏時反擊。蒙古這一套打法在純野戰中極為有效，一旦碰上宋軍深溝高壘、依險築寨的防禦，效率便急劇下降，這也是其後蒙古在南方攻城屢吃虧的根源。
tacticsEn: The campaigning of this year followed the logic of steppe cavalry: no prolonged wrestling with the defenders before their walls, but rapid movement to cut communications, to divide the enemy country and to force the garrisons to split their forces. Moving south, Pusuge's detachment kept to rough tracks in the mountains, avoided the towns and large stockades where the Song concentrated troops, and struck instead at supply columns, drove off cattle and cut the roads from Guanzhong and northern Sichuan to the front, dragging the frontier garrisons into a war of defence in which every position had to be fortified and every appeal for help answered in turn. Once inside Song territory, Mongol riders who met the Song crossbow formations and the field of fire of the shenpi bows normally turned to outflank them and cut their rear rather than charge head-on; when the Song held a stockade they first showered the walls with arrows and sealed the entrances, waiting until the Song relief troops were exhausted or their supply was cut before deciding whether to press on or withdraw. On the wall the core of the Song tactic was the crossbow: longbowmen covered the long distances, crossbowmen fired in turn from behind the crenellations against the men climbing over the parapet and against those covering the siege engines, while reserves inside the city stood ready for night attacks on the camp when the Mongol horses were tired. The Mongol way was devastating in open field; once it met Song defences of deep ditches, high ramparts and stockades set on difficult ground, its efficiency fell away sharply, and that is the root of the heavy losses the Mongols would later suffer before the cities of the south.
data: 可以核對的數字有限，但仍有幾項可用。一二〇六年蒙古完成建國，行大札撒，怯薛宿衛初置千人，其後逐步增至萬人；《元史·兵志》記大定制時分九十五個千戶領諸部百姓，可見其軍制已從部落式徵發轉為常設編制。從斡難河一帶的蒙古本部到宋國陝蜀邊境，途程逾三千五百里，騎兵往返尚可控制在數十日之內，但沿途水草與馬料都要就地補充，遠征的極限在於草場與糧食，而不在戰鬥力。蒙古這次出兵沒有留下確切的兵力數目，常見的說法是偏師輕裝、人數有限，攻城器械極為簡陋，連填壕用的木板與繩索都要就地備辦。宋軍方面，南宋全國的兵額常被記作七十萬上下，各時期增減不一，川陝沿邊的駐軍以數萬計，卻分散在數千處堡寨，每處常不過數百人；這種分散守禦的部署看似處處有兵，實際上很難集中起足以反擊騎兵大隊的力量。射程方面，宋制神臂弓有效射程約二百步，蒙古的反曲角弓在平地上的有效射擊距離大致相當，若在坡地仰射或順風，蒙古箭手的實際威脅範圍還要更大。至於戰役的具體時日與雙方損失，現存兩方面的編年都沒有留下可靠記載，通行說法只給出夏秋之交這樣的概略。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, but a few can be given. In 1206 the Mongol Empire was founded, the Yassa was promulgated, and the keshig guard was first raised with a thousand men, later growing to ten thousand; the History of Yuan in its treatise on the military records that ninety-five thousand-households were allotted to the various peoples at the great constitutional settlement, showing that the army had passed from tribal levy to standing organisation. From the Mongol homeland on the Onon river to the Song frontier in Shaanxi and Sichuan lay more than three thousand five hundred li, a ride of perhaps a month and more for the horses, but along the way water, grass and fodder had to be taken locally, so the limit of a distant expedition lay in pasture and supply rather than in fighting power. No reliable figure survives for the strength of this force; the usual description is of a lightly equipped detachment of limited numbers with very crude siege equipment, so that even the planks and rope for filling ditches had to be got on the spot. On the Song side the paper strength of the imperial army is commonly given at around seven hundred thousand men, though it rose and fell with the years, and the frontier garrisons of Shaanxi and Sichuan numbered in the tens of thousands but were scattered among thousands of stockades with a few hundred men in each; such dispersal looked like strength everywhere, yet allowed no concentration of a force able to strike back at a Mongol column. As for ranges, the Song shenpi bow threw about two hundred paces, and the Mongol recurved bow had a comparable effective distance on level ground; on a slope or with the wind the reach of the Mongol archers was in practice greater still. As for the exact dates of the engagement and the losses on either side, the surviving chronicles of both parties record nothing reliable, and only a general statement such as the summer and autumn of 1206 can be given.
cause: 打起來的直接原因，是蒙古在統一草原之後需要新的財源與通道，而南宋拒絕向蒙古提供貢賦，也不斷接應其西部的敵對力量。一二〇六年成吉思汗在斡難河完成建國，隨即把目光投向南方：西夏已經在連年征伐下求和稱臣，蒙古騎兵可以直接從河套與河西一線南下，不必再翻越賀蘭山；宋廷在開禧北伐中把主力放在河南、兩淮與江淮一線，西北邊防相對空虛，這在蒙古的偵察網絡裡是清楚可見的弱點。更深一層，蒙古需要以持續的邊境壓力迫使宋朝正視自己的實力與要求，測試宋廷在邊境上的反應速度、援軍調度能力與和談傾向，同時藉著繳獲的牲畜、糧食與布帛維持遠征隊伍的供給。對南宋而言，這是北線與西北線同時受壓的年份：北有金，西有新興的蒙古，而朝廷正在開禧北伐的成敗上爭論不休，川陝邊軍得到的援兵與物資都相當有限。兩方面的壓力疊加，遂有了這場發生在宋陝蜀邊境的攻擊。
causeEn: The immediate reason for the fighting was that the Mongols, having unified the steppe, needed new revenue and new lines of communication, while the Song refused to pay them tribute and went on supporting the hostile forces to their west. Having completed the foundation of the empire at the Onon in 1206, Genghis Khan turned his eyes south: Xixia, worn down by repeated campaigns, had sued for peace and submitted, so that Mongol riders could advance directly from the Hetao and Hexi lines without climbing again over the Helan mountains; and the Song court, absorbed in the Kaixi northern expedition, had concentrated its main strength in Henan, the Huai and the Jiang-Huai, leaving the north-western frontier comparatively thin, a weakness plainly visible to Mongol scouting. More deeply, the Mongols needed sustained border pressure to force the Song court to recognise their strength and their demands, to test the speed of the Song response, the mobilisation of relief armies and the mood for negotiation, and at the same time to sustain the expedition with cattle, grain and cloth taken as they went. For the Song this was a year when pressure came from two directions at once, the Jin in the north and the new Mongols in the west, while the court was torn over the results of the Kaixi expedition, and the frontier armies of Shaanxi and Sichuan received neither reinforcements nor supplies on any generous scale. The two pressures overlapping produced the attack on the Song's Shaanxi and Sichuan border.
impact: 這場邊境攻擊的直接後果有限，卻在兩方面留下了深遠的痕跡。對南宋而言，蒙古第一次成建制地出現在四川與陝西的邊防線上，逼得四川宣撫司把修築城寨、整頓民兵、補充弩兵與弓器列為常務，沿邊形成以堡寨為節點的梯次防禦；弩與神臂弓在這些城寨裡成為守軍的骨幹，弩兵與弩匠的編制、弩矢與弦料的儲備，也因此被正式寫進軍器的常規儲備之中。對蒙古而言，這是一次對宋國防體系的初次實地偵察：他們確認了宋軍在山地城寨的防禦頑強，也看出了宋廷援軍調度與後勤補給的弱點，這些認識在十餘年後蒙古大舉南下的時候被重新提起。外交上，蒙古由此加強了對宋的接觸，隨後數年雙方互遣使節，趙良弼以宋使身份滯留蒙古十餘年寫成的《蒙靼備錄》，正是這一時期接觸的產物，它讓中原第一次系統地看見蒙古的騎兵規模與行軍方式。同時，這場衝突也加深了南宋內部關於北伐與議和的爭論，最終在開禧北伐失敗、韓侂胄被殺之後，朝廷轉向對金讓步的嘉定和議，得以暫時集中力量應對西面與北面的變局。
impactEn: The direct consequences of the raid were modest, but it left deep marks on both sides. For the Song, the Mongols appeared for the first time as an organised force on the Sichuan and Shaanxi frontier, forcing the pacification commission to make the building of stockades, the organisation of the militia and the stocking of crossbows and bow equipment a permanent matter of duty, and forming along the border a graded defence in which the crossbow and the shenpi bow became the backbone of the garrisons; the establishment of crossbowmen and crossbow-makers, and the stores of bolts and string, were accordingly written into the regular inventory of military equipment. For the Mongols it was a first reconnaissance of the Song defence system in the field: they confirmed the tenacity of Song positions in the mountains and at the same time saw the weakness of the Song court's relief system and supply lines, and these impressions were recalled when the Mongols came south in force more than a decade later. Diplomatically, contact with the Song intensified, envoys passed in both directions in the following years, and the Mengda Beilu, written by Zhao Liangbi during more than a decade at the Mongol court as a Song envoy, is the product of that contact, giving the Central Plains its first systematic view of the size and marching habits of the Mongol cavalry. The clash also deepened the argument inside the Song between the northern expedition and negotiation, and after the failure of Kaixi and the killing of Han Tuozhou the court turned to the Jiading peace with Jin, winning a breathing space in which to concentrate on the changed situation in the west and the north.
result: 就戰果而言，這場攻擊並沒有改變宋蒙的基本格局。蒙古偏師在宋境內的推進最終有限：宋軍倚靠堡寨與山地的防禦成功抵擋了蒙古騎兵的直接衝撞，邊地城寨雖屢遭掠奪，卻大致守住了；蒙古沒有攻下任何一座宋軍控制的主要城池，也沒有長期佔領宋境土地，遠征的補給限制迫使這支偏師在取得牲畜與糧食之後退回北方。從蒙古的角度看，這是一場代價小、收穫有限但情報價值很高的試探；從宋的角度看，則是一場邊防消耗戰，守軍付出的是錢糧、器械與沿邊田產的損失，換來的卻是對這支新型敵人的第一次直接認識。仆散揆的這次出兵之後，蒙古把主要精力轉回西夏與北方草原，並在數年之後選擇金朝作為第一個大規模進攻的對象；南宋則在開禧北伐失敗、嘉定和議簽訂之後，趁中原稍事休息的間隙加固川陝防務。當蒙古真正大舉南下已是十餘年後的事，攻宋的主帥與戰役規模，都與這一次完全不同。
resultEn: As for the military outcome, the attack did not alter the basic pattern of Song-Mongol relations. The advance of the Mongol detachment inside Song territory was limited in the end: the Song relied on stockades and on difficult ground to check the direct charge of the cavalry, and although the frontier forts were repeatedly plundered they were broadly held; the Mongols took no major Song city, occupied no Song land for long, and the limits of supply forced the column to withdraw north once it had taken cattle and grain. From the Mongol point of view this was a probe of low cost and modest return but of high intelligence value; from the Song point of view it was a war of attrition on the frontier, paid for in money, grain, equipment and the loss of fields along the border, and it bought the Song a first direct acquaintance with a new kind of enemy. After this expedition the Mongols turned their main effort back to Xixia and to the northern steppe and, some years later, chose the Jin as their first large-scale target; the Song, after the failure of the Kaixi expedition and the signing of the Jiading peace, used the respite in the Central Plains to strengthen the defences of Shaanxi and Sichuan. When the Mongols really moved south in force came more than a decade later, with different commanders and a wholly different scale of war.
